report_summary: A notably calibrated account distinguishes intended coordination, proxy workarounds and browser-mediated write attempts from verified outcomes. It accurately separates June 4 deletions from the sustained June 18 wave and treats attribution and cleanup rationale as uncertain; earlier-ablation source mapping limits exact network comparison.
